```{r setup}
#| include: false
# Render with:  quarto render 05_skim_report.qmd
# Data: run 04_prepare_report_data.R first (writes <skim_dir>/report_data/).
report_data <- "C:/models/matsim-libs/contribs/sbb-extensions/src/project/output/skims_muc/report_data"

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(sf)
  library(ggplot2)
})

MODES <- c("car", "bus", "btm", "all")
PT_MODES <- c("bus", "btm", "all")
MODE_LABELS <- c(car = "car", bus = "bus", btm = "bus + tram/metro", all = "bus + tram/metro + rail")
MODE_COLORS <- c("car" = "#5f6b7a", "bus" = "#d95f02", "bus + tram/metro" = "#1b9e77", "bus + tram/metro + rail" = "#7570b3")
DIST_BANDS <- c("intrazonal", "0-2 km", "2-5 km", "5-10 km", "10-25 km", "25-50 km", "50-100 km", ">100 km")
mode_f <- function(m) factor(MODE_LABELS[m], levels = MODE_LABELS)

meta <- fread(file.path(report_data, "meta.csv"), sep = ";")
mget_meta <- function(k) meta[item == k, value]
selected_zones <- trimws(strsplit(mget_meta("selected_zones"), ",")[[1]])

# place names of the selected zones (zones not listed are shown with their number only)
ZONE_NAMES <- c("2641" = "München-Moosach", "3441" = "München-Fürstenried West", "517" = "Augsburg",
                "4405" = "Rosenheim", "3084" = "München-Maxvorstadt")
zname <- function(z) ifelse(z %in% names(ZONE_NAMES), ZONE_NAMES[z], "")
zlab <- function(z) ifelse(zname(z) == "", z, paste0(z, " ", zname(z)))

od_sel <- fread(file.path(report_data, "od_selected.csv"), sep = ";", colClasses = list(character = c("from", "to")))
od_sel[, dist_band := factor(dist_band, levels = DIST_BANDS)]
od_sel[, mode_label := mode_f(mode)]

per_origin <- fread(file.path(report_data, "per_origin.csv"), sep = ";", colClasses = list(character = "from"))
per_origin[, mode_label := mode_f(mode)]

smp <- fread(file.path(report_data, "od_sample.csv"), sep = ";", colClasses = list(character = c("from", "to")))
smp[, dist_band := factor(dist_band, levels = DIST_BANDS)]

bq <- fread(file.path(report_data, "band_quantiles.csv"), sep = ";")
bq[, dist_band := factor(dist_band, levels = DIST_BANDS)]
bq[, mode_label := mode_f(mode)]

zones <- st_read(file.path(report_data, "zones.gpkg"), quiet = TRUE)
pts_file <- file.path(report_data, "sampling_points.csv")
pts <- if (file.exists(pts_file)) fread(pts_file, sep = ";", colClasses = list(character = "ZONE")) else NULL

theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 11))
map_theme <- theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(),
                   strip.text = element_text(size = 11))

map_theme <- map_theme + theme(legend.position = "right", legend.key.height = unit(1.6, "cm"), axis.title = element_blank(),
                               plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"), strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))
zone_cent <- suppressWarnings(st_centroid(zones[zones$zone_id %in% selected_zones, ]))
zone_cent$label <- zlab(zone_cent$zone_id)

# box around a zone with the aspect ratio of the study area (so region and zoom maps have the same size)
reg_bb <- unname(as.numeric(st_bbox(zones)))                     # xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax
reg_aspect <- (reg_bb[4] - reg_bb[2]) / (reg_bb[3] - reg_bb[1])
zoom_box <- function(z, half_width_m = 30000) {
  c0 <- unname(as.numeric(st_coordinates(zone_cent[zone_cent$zone_id == z, ])[1, 1:2]))
  c(xmin = c0[1] - half_width_m, xmax = c0[1] + half_width_m,
    ymin = c0[2] - half_width_m * reg_aspect, ymax = c0[2] + half_width_m * reg_aspect)
}

# map of one value per zone, one facet per mode (2 x 2 grid so each map is large)
#   highlight: origin zone (red outline + dot + name); box: zoom extent (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)
facet_map <- function(values, fill_scale, title, highlight = NULL, ncol = 2, box = NULL, subtitle = NULL) {
  m <- merge(zones, values, by = "zone_id")
  p <- ggplot(m) + geom_sf(aes(fill = value), colour = if (is.null(box)) NA else "grey97", linewidth = 0.05) +
    fill_scale + facet_wrap(~mode_label, ncol = ncol) +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle, fill = NULL) + map_theme
  if (!is.null(highlight)) {
    o <- zone_cent[zone_cent$zone_id == highlight, ]
    # origin: zone outline + hollow ring (no label: the name is in the title, a label would hide the map)
    p <- p + geom_sf(data = zones[zones$zone_id == highlight, ], fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
      geom_sf(data = o, shape = 21, fill = NA, colour = "white", size = 5, stroke = 2.2) +
      geom_sf(data = o, shape = 21, fill = NA, colour = "black", size = 5, stroke = 1)
  }
  if (!is.null(box)) p <- p + coord_sf(xlim = box[c("xmin", "xmax")], ylim = box[c("ymin", "ymax")], expand = FALSE)
  p
}

# travel time: binned, short = red, long = blue, no connection = light grey
tt_breaks <- c(15, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120, 180, 240)
tt_scale <- scale_fill_fermenter(palette = "Spectral", direction = 1, breaks = tt_breaks, limits = c(0, 300),
                                 oob = scales::squish, na.value = "grey90", name = "minutes",
                                 guide = guide_coloursteps(show.limits = FALSE))
share_scale <- function(opt = "viridis") scale_fill_viridis_c(option = opt, limits = c(0, 1), na.value = "grey90",
                                                              breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25))

fmt <- function(x, d = 1) ifelse(is.na(x), "–", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d))

# start / end of a nested tabset inside an "asis" chunk
tabset_start <- function() cat("\n\n::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
tabset_end <- function() cat("\n\n:::\n\n")
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

## About

### What this report shows

Zone-to-zone skims for **`r mget_meta("n_zones")` zones** (`r format(as.numeric(mget_meta("n_od_pairs")), big.mark = ",")` OD pairs),
calculated with `CalculateSegmentedSkimsMuc` (written `r mget_meta("skims_written")`). Five zones can be inspected in detail:
**`r paste(zlab(selected_zones), collapse = ", ")`**. Region-wide plots use all OD pairs (maps, box plots) or a random sample of
`r format(as.numeric(mget_meta("sample_size")), big.mark = ",")` interzonal OD pairs (scatter plots).

```{r overview-map}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5.2
#| layout-ncol: 2
sel <- zones[zones$zone_id %in% selected_zones, ]
cent <- zone_cent
xy <- st_coordinates(cent)
cent$x <- xy[, 1]; cent$y <- xy[, 2]
# zones in Munich are close together: show them in a separate zoom map
in_muc <- grepl("^München", zname(cent$zone_id))
ov_theme <- map_theme + theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"))

if (any(in_muc)) {
  # landscape window (same shape as the figure) around the Munich zones, wide enough for the labels
  mx <- range(xy[in_muc, 1]); my <- range(xy[in_muc, 2])
  half_h <- diff(my) / 2 + 2500
  half_w <- max(diff(mx) / 2 + 9000, half_h / 0.74)
  half_h <- half_w * 0.74
  cx <- mean(mx); cy <- mean(my)
  mb <- st_bbox(c(xmin = cx - half_w, ymin = cy - half_h, xmax = cx + half_w, ymax = cy + half_h), crs = st_crs(zones))
  muc_box <- st_as_sfc(mb)
}

# left: whole study area
p1 <- ggplot() + geom_sf(data = zones, fill = "grey93", colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.05) +
  geom_point(data = st_drop_geometry(cent), aes(x, y), shape = 21, fill = "red", colour = "white", size = 3.5, stroke = 0.8) +
  geom_label(data = st_drop_geometry(cent[!in_muc, ]), aes(x, y, label = label), nudge_y = 7000, size = 3.6,
             fill = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Study area") + ov_theme
if (any(in_muc)) {
  p1 <- p1 + geom_sf(data = muc_box, fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
    annotate("label", x = mb[["xmax"]], y = mb[["ymax"]], label = "München (see right)", hjust = 0, vjust = 0,
             size = 3.6, fill = "white", linewidth = 0.2)
}
p1 <- p1 + coord_sf(expand = TRUE)
print(p1)

# right: Munich zoom with the city zones and their names
if (any(in_muc)) {
  cm <- st_drop_geometry(cent[in_muc, ])
  cm <- cm[order(-cm$y), ]
  # spread the labels: northernmost above, southernmost below, the others to the right
  cm$nx <- 0; cm$ny <- 0; cm$hj <- 0.5
  cm$ny[1] <- 900
  if (nrow(cm) > 1) cm$ny[nrow(cm)] <- -900
  if (nrow(cm) > 2) { mid <- 2:(nrow(cm) - 1); cm$nx[mid] <- 700; cm$hj[mid] <- 0 }
  p2 <- ggplot() + geom_sf(data = st_crop(zones, mb), fill = "grey95", colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.1) +
    geom_sf(data = sel[sel$zone_id %in% cm$zone_id, ], fill = "#fcbba1", colour = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(data = cm, aes(x, y), shape = 21, fill = "red", colour = "white", size = 3, stroke = 0.8) +
    geom_label(data = cm, aes(x + nx, y + ny, label = label, hjust = hj), size = 3.6, fill = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    coord_sf(xlim = unname(c(mb[["xmin"]], mb[["xmax"]])), ylim = unname(c(mb[["ymin"]], mb[["ymax"]])), expand = FALSE) +
    labs(title = "München") + ov_theme
  print(p2)
}
```

### Skims

| Skim | Network / schedule | Main mode | Feeder modes |
|---|---|---|---|
| car | car network, free-flow speed | car | – |
| bus | bus (+ ferry) | bus, ferry | – |
| bus + tram/metro | bus + tram + U-Bahn | tram, U-Bahn | bus, ferry |
| bus + tram/metro + rail | all PT | rail (S-Bahn, regional trains) | bus, ferry, tram, U-Bahn |

### Settings

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| Departure window (PT) | 07:30–08:30; routing trees every 120 s from 06:30 to 09:30 |
| Sampling points | 3 per zone; all skims use the same points |
| Walking | 3 km/h, straight-line distance × 1.3 |
| Stop search radius | 1,000 m (+200 m if no stop is found) |
| Max. transfer walk | 500 m straight-line |
| Car | free-flow speeds (no congestion) |

### Definitions

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Total travel time | door to door: walk access + in-vehicle time + transfer walk + transfer wait + walk egress. Waiting at the first stop is **not** included (it is in the adaption time). |
| PT access / main / egress | in-vehicle time before the first main-mode leg / from the first to the last main-mode leg / after the last main-mode leg |
| Main share | in-vehicle time on the main segment ÷ total in-vehicle time. 1 = no feeder legs. |
| Availability | share of the hour (and of the 3 × 3 point pairs) in which the best connection uses the main mode. **Car:** 1 if the car time is finite, 0 otherwise. |
| Share reachable | per origin zone: share of all other zones with a finite travel time |
| No connection (`Infinity`) | no connection using the main mode at all. Shown in grey on maps and as "–" in tables. |
| Door-to-door speed | straight-line distance ÷ total travel time |

Note: for very short and intrazonal trips the PT values are unreliable (stops near the destination are reached "walking only" and are skipped by the router). Use the walk skim for those.

### Overall

```{r overall}
ov <- per_origin[, .(`share reachable` = fmt(mean(share_reachable) * 100, 1),
                     `mean availability` = fmt(mean(mean_availability), 2),
                     `median main share` = fmt(median(median_main_share, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
                     `median travel time [min]` = fmt(median(median_tt_min, na.rm = TRUE), 0)), by = mode_label][order(mode_label)]
setnames(ov, c("mode_label", "share reachable"), c("mode", "share of OD pairs reachable [%]"))
knitr::kable(ov, align = "lrrrr")
```

## Zone explorer

```{r zone-explorer}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 13
#| fig-height: 5
COMP <- c(walk_access_time = "walk access", pt_access_ivt = "PT access (feeder)", pt_main_ivt = "PT main",
          pt_egress_ivt = "PT egress (feeder)", pt_transfer_walk_time = "transfer walk",
          pt_transfer_wait_time = "transfer wait", walk_egress_time = "walk egress", car = "car")
COMP_COLORS <- c("walk access" = "#bdbdbd", "PT access (feeder)" = "#fdae6b", "PT main" = "#3182bd",
                 "PT egress (feeder)" = "#fd8d3c", "transfer walk" = "#a1d99b", "transfer wait" = "#e7ba52",
                 "walk egress" = "#737373", "car" = "#5f6b7a")

tabset_start()
for (z in selected_zones) {
  cat("\n\n### ", zlab(z), "\n\n", sep = "")
  dz <- od_sel[from == z & to %in% selected_zones]
  dz[, to := factor(to, levels = c(z, setdiff(selected_zones, z)))]

  # --- table
  tab <- dz[order(to, mode_label), .(
    to = zlab(as.character(to)), mode = as.character(mode_label), `beeline km` = fmt(beeline / 1000, 1),
    `total min` = fmt(total_travel_time / 60, 1), `walk acc` = fmt(walk_access_time / 60, 1),
    `PT acc` = fmt(pt_access_ivt / 60, 1), `PT main` = fmt(pt_main_ivt / 60, 1), `PT egr` = fmt(pt_egress_ivt / 60, 1),
    `walk egr` = fmt(walk_egress_time / 60, 1), `trf walk` = fmt(pt_transfer_walk_time / 60, 1),
    `trf wait` = fmt(pt_transfer_wait_time / 60, 1), transfers = fmt(pt_transfer_count, 2),
    `main share` = fmt(main_share_time, 2), availability = fmt(main_mode_availability, 2),
    `freq /h` = fmt(pt_frequency, 1), `dist km` = fmt(total_distance / 1000, 1))]
  cat("**Travel times from ", zlab(z), " to the other selected zones** (minutes; first row group: intrazonal)\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(knitr::kable(tab, format = "html", align = "llrrrrrrrrrrrrrr", table.attr = "class=\"table table-sm table-striped\""), sep = "\n")

  # --- stacked components
  long <- melt(dz[mode != "car", c("to", "mode_label", names(COMP)[1:7]), with = FALSE],
               id.vars = c("to", "mode_label"), variable.name = "component", value.name = "sec")
  car <- dz[mode == "car", .(to, mode_label, component = "car", sec = total_travel_time)]
  long <- rbind(long, car)
  long[, component := factor(COMP[as.character(component)], levels = COMP)]
  long[, minutes := sec / 60]
  nocon <- dz[is.na(total_travel_time), .(to, mode_label)]
  p <- ggplot(long[!is.na(minutes)], aes(x = minutes, y = to, fill = component)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~mode_label, nrow = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = COMP_COLORS, drop = FALSE) + scale_y_discrete(labels = zlab) +
    labs(x = "minutes", y = "destination zone", fill = NULL, title = paste0("Travel time components from ", zlab(z)),
         subtitle = "missing bar = no connection with the main mode") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  if (nrow(nocon) > 0) p <- p + geom_text(data = nocon, aes(x = 0, y = to, label = "no connection"), inherit.aes = FALSE,
                                          hjust = 0, size = 3, colour = "grey40")
  print(p)
  cat("\n\n")

  # --- location
  zz <- zones[zones$zone_id == z, ]
  box <- st_bbox(st_buffer(zz, 3000))
  nb <- st_crop(zones, box)
  pz <- ggplot() + geom_sf(data = nb, fill = "grey95", colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_sf(data = zz, fill = "#fde0dd", colour = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
    coord_sf(xlim = box[c(1, 3)], ylim = box[c(2, 4)], expand = FALSE) +
    labs(title = paste0(zlab(z), " and its sampling points"), x = NULL, y = NULL) + map_theme
  if (!is.null(pts)) {
    pp <- st_as_sf(pts[ZONE == z], coords = c("X", "Y"), crs = st_crs(zones))
    pz <- pz + geom_sf(data = pp, colour = "black", size = 2.5) +
      geom_sf_text(data = pp, aes(label = POINT_INDEX), nudge_y = 150, size = 3)
  }
  print(pz)
  cat("\n\n")
}
tabset_end()
```

## Speed by mode

```{r speed}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 13
#| fig-height: 5.5
spd_q <- bq[measure == "d2d_speed_kmh"]
long_smp <- melt(smp, id.vars = c("from", "to", "beeline", "dist_band", "walk_time"),
                 measure.vars = paste0(MODES, "_tt"), variable.name = "mode", value.name = "tt")
long_smp[, mode := sub("_tt$", "", mode)][, mode_label := mode_f(mode)]
walk_k <- smp[beeline > 0, median(walk_time / beeline)] * 1000 / 60   # min per km
y_max <- quantile(long_smp$tt / 60, 0.995, na.rm = TRUE)

tabset_start()
for (z in selected_zones) {
  cat("\n\n### ", zlab(z), "\n\n", sep = "")
  dz <- od_sel[from == z & intrazonal == FALSE & !is.na(total_travel_time) & total_travel_time > 0]
  dz[, speed := beeline / total_travel_time * 3.6]

  p <- ggplot(spd_q, aes(x = dist_band, fill = mode_label)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(ymin = p05, lower = p25, middle = p50, upper = p75, ymax = p95), stat = "identity",
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.85), width = 0.75, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_point(data = dz, aes(x = dist_band, y = speed, colour = mode_label),
               position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.85), size = 0.6, alpha = 0.5,
               inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = MODE_COLORS) + scale_colour_manual(values = MODE_COLORS) +
    labs(x = "beeline distance band", y = "door-to-door speed [km/h]", fill = NULL,
         title = "Door-to-door speed by distance band",
         subtitle = paste0("boxes: all OD pairs (whiskers 5 %–95 %); dots: OD pairs from ", zlab(z))) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  print(p)
  cat("\n\n")

  p <- ggplot(long_smp[!is.na(tt)], aes(beeline / 1000, tt / 60)) +
    geom_point(colour = "grey70", size = 0.3, alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_abline(slope = walk_k, intercept = 0, colour = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(data = dz, aes(beeline / 1000, total_travel_time / 60, colour = mode_label), size = 0.8, alpha = 0.7,
               inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~mode_label, nrow = 1) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = MODE_COLORS) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_max)) +
    labs(x = "beeline distance [km]", y = "total travel time [min]",
         title = "Travel time vs beeline distance",
         subtitle = paste0("grey: random sample of all OD pairs; coloured: OD pairs from ", zlab(z), "; dashed: walking"))
  print(p)
  cat("\n\n")
}
tabset_end()
```

## PT vs car

```{r pt-vs-car}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 13
#| fig-height: 5.5
ratio_q <- bq[measure == "pt_car_ratio"]
car_sel <- od_sel[mode == "car", .(from, to, car_tt = total_travel_time)]
pc_smp <- melt(smp[!is.na(car_tt) & car_tt > 0], id.vars = c("from", "to", "dist_band", "car_tt"),
               measure.vars = paste0(PT_MODES, "_tt"), variable.name = "mode", value.name = "pt_tt")
pc_smp[, mode := sub("_tt$", "", mode)][, mode_label := mode_f(mode)]
lim <- c(0, quantile(c(pc_smp$pt_tt, pc_smp$car_tt) / 60, 0.995, na.rm = TRUE))

cat("Ratio = PT total travel time ÷ car travel time (free flow). Below 1: PT faster than car.\n\n")
rt <- dcast(ratio_q, dist_band ~ mode_label, value.var = "p50")
rt <- rt[, lapply(.SD, function(x) if (is.numeric(x)) fmt(x, 2) else as.character(x))]
cat("**Median PT / car ratio by distance band (all OD pairs)**\n\n")
cat(knitr::kable(rt, format = "html", table.attr = "class=\"table table-sm\""), sep = "\n")

tabset_start()
for (z in selected_zones) {
  cat("\n\n### ", zlab(z), "\n\n", sep = "")
  dz <- merge(od_sel[from == z & mode != "car" & intrazonal == FALSE, .(from, to, dist_band, mode_label, pt_tt = total_travel_time)],
              car_sel, by = c("from", "to"))
  dz <- dz[!is.na(pt_tt) & !is.na(car_tt) & car_tt > 0]
  dz[, ratio := pt_tt / car_tt]

  p <- ggplot(ratio_q, aes(x = dist_band, fill = mode_label)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, colour = "red") +
    geom_boxplot(aes(ymin = p05, lower = p25, middle = p50, upper = p75, ymax = p95), stat = "identity",
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.85), width = 0.75, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_point(data = dz, aes(x = dist_band, y = ratio, colour = mode_label),
               position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.85), size = 0.6, alpha = 0.5,
               inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_y_log10() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = MODE_COLORS) + scale_colour_manual(values = MODE_COLORS) +
    labs(x = "beeline distance band", y = "PT time / car time (log scale)", fill = NULL,
         title = "PT vs car by distance band",
         subtitle = paste0("boxes: all OD pairs (whiskers 5 %–95 %); dots: OD pairs from ", zlab(z), "; red: equal time")) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  print(p)
  cat("\n\n")

  p <- ggplot(pc_smp[!is.na(pt_tt)], aes(car_tt / 60, pt_tt / 60)) +
    geom_point(colour = "grey70", size = 0.3, alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "red") +
    geom_point(data = dz, aes(car_tt / 60, pt_tt / 60, colour = mode_label), size = 0.8, alpha = 0.7,
               inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~mode_label, nrow = 1) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = MODE_COLORS) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = lim, ylim = lim) +
    labs(x = "car travel time [min]", y = "PT travel time [min]", title = "PT vs car travel time",
         subtitle = paste0("grey: random sample of all OD pairs; coloured: OD pairs from ", zlab(z), "; above the red line: car faster"))
  print(p)
  cat("\n\n")
}
tabset_end()
```
